name: smwmusic-mario-eisouoku-illusionary-blossom-of-cranium-prayer-distant-sea-of-mangroves
title: Mario Eisouoku ~ Illusionary Blossom of Cranium Prayer - Distant Sea of Mangroves
description:
The stage 3 theme from マリオ永草億　～ Illusionary Blossom of Cranium Prayer.

The first song composed for the project, and it may sound slightly less Touhou-y. Funnily enough, I first pictured a very humid jungle when composing it, and it ended up being used in a snowy forest.
